BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: XML documents are received from remote requests.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: A crafted DOCTYPE with external entities is enough; no special conditions are needed.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: The vulnerable endpoint is reachable without authentication.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: The attacker submits the XML directly; no victim action is needed.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: Entity resolution runs inside the same parser and process.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: External entities can read local files and reach internal resources.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: Entity expansion reads data but does not modify it.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: Recursive entity expansion can cause limited resource exhaustion.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
